plugin.notes: 2.7.1: the plugin reads none of Orca's private files (it asks Orca's CLI for the local port) and the relay Worker redeploys only when you click Update relay unless you opt in. 2.7.0: see and remove paired phones under Paired devices on Orca's Mobile page.

relay.notes: Relay 1.2.0: Deploy-button Workers are locked to the first desktop (no one else can use your Worker or its quota), max 4 phone connections per IP, smaller pre-connection buffer.
